summary: Fix issue #608 by making continuity-storage clock assertions deterministic across a second boundary.

delivery.outcome: The continuity-storage commit/rebuild regression is deterministic across a wall-clock second boundary while retaining exact index and event assertions.
nonGoals: No production clock or index format changes.
No weakened assertions, skips, protected checks or publication authority changes.

architecture.decision: Patch continuity.utc_now to one fixed UTC timestamp only within the existing commit/rebuild distinct-storage-parent test. Keep every storage, event, index, and rebuild assertion unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert; preserve the ticket branch and adopted releases.

validation.evidence: Paired isolated diagnostic reproduces the original mismatch with a clock crossing a second; fixed test retains exact equality and passes.
Full storage suite and required protected Linux/Windows and OneDev checks pass on the publication candidate.
Canonical scope and delivery gate passes without policy changes.
